statusDetail: Entry-page recon was blocked by an HTTP 403 Cloudflare response that displays an upstream server-stopped message. No intended site page or journey was reachable, so this is retained as an incomplete blocked run.

page.notes: The response is a Cloudflare-served Chinese error page, not enough evidence to identify the intended application.

artifacts.caption: Mobile entry capture showing only the upstream error response.
Rendered DOM contains only the Chinese server-stopped error and Cloudflare scripts.
Link/form/heading recon: zero links, forms, and headings; error title only.
curl response headers show HTTP 403 served by Cloudflare.
DNS resolution confirms the host resolves to Cloudflare addresses.
Security-header capture of the 403 response; not treated as the intended app response.
Network archive for the blocked entry load, including two 403 responses.
Compact HAR summary: seven requests and two HTTP 403 responses.
Raw and rendered discovery both received the unavailable response; raw fetch status 403.
Pinned Modern Web Guidance 0.0.172 catalog consulted before judgement stopped at the access blocker.
Exact 58-pair atomic coverage manifest derived from principles.json.
Per-check evidence plan, preserved even though execution stopped at entry-page recon.
Atomic coverage validator output records 58 blocked checks and the expected publication-gate failure.
